narrative: Material PL2__MDC55497 shows moderate daily demand variability (CV=0.416) across 227 working days from March 2025 to March 2026, with a visible upward trend in later months. Lead times are highly unstable (CV=0.715), ranging from near-zero to 3.67 days, making lead time variability the dominant risk driver at 78.3% of total variance. The current SAP policy carries zero safety stock, leaving the material fully exposed to stockout risk. An (r,Q) policy with EOQ-optimised order quantity of 2,785 units and a safety stock of 1,037 units delivers the mandated 95% service level while remaining well within the 9,934-unit storage constraint.

research_insights.selection_rationale: The material has continuous, moderately variable demand with no intermittency issues, making a continuous-review (r,Q) policy appropriate. EOQ balances ordering and holding costs optimally given the known cost parameters, and the Normal safety stock formula is justified by the near-normal demand distribution.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity of 9,934 units is not binding: safety_stock (1,037) + order_quantity (2,785) = 3,822 units, leaving 6,113 units of headroom. No capacity-driven service degradation expected.
